policies.denominator: Measured valid candidate votes, including Other; no D/R renormalization or unmeasured-vote imputation
policies.fusion: Combine same-candidate fusion lines using the audited district/name/stage references
policies.2016: Classify Peter Welch as Democratic using the official party table
policies.2018: Unavailable: uncertified NC-09 is not an accepted historical proxy
policies.2020: Preserve certified NY-14 +30 Republican votes and denominator correction; exclude uncounted write-ins
policies.sensitivity: Final-RCV candidate totals are comparison evidence only
policies.activation: Newly computed runs only; existing saved runs and replay remain unchanged; no automatic reruns, backfills or exports
